prompt:

Composition: square canvas, one centered nearly frontal head-and-upper-torso bust, subtle natural three-quarter shoulder angle from source and face toward viewer, rounded lower shoulder silhouette, all head, hair and both ears fully contained with generous transparent margins. No hands or lower body.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha. Remove the plain indoor wall, source shadows outside the character and all scenery. No other people, props, background circle, badge, frame, text or watermark.
